BlackRock, Mastercard & Franklin Templeton Explore XRP Ledger for Payments, Tokenization & RLUSD Stablecoin Settlement | Ripple Big News
BlackRock, Mastercard, and Franklin Templeton are actively evaluating the XRP Ledger (XRPL) as powerful infrastructure for real-world payments, asset tokenization, and stablecoin settlements. 

Ripple executive Odelia Torteman confirmed the major institutions see XRPL as a decentralized network where XRP serves as a bridge asset for fast, efficient multi-asset transfers — far beyond just trading.
In this video, we break down the latest institutional adoption wave on the XRP Ledger, including:

Built-in Automated Market Maker (AMM), decentralized exchange (DEX), and trust lines for compliant KYC flows

Mastercard’s groundbreaking November 2025 pilot with Gemini and Ripple using RLUSD for card payment settlements on a public blockchain
Ripple + Securitize integration allowing BlackRock’s BUIDL fund and VanEck’s VBILL holders to convert tokenized holdings into RLUSD for 24/7 on-chain liquidity

Franklin Templeton and DBS Bank partnership integrating tokenized money market funds with RLUSD for lending and trading

Plus, insights from the CoinDesk Research report (commissioned by Ripple) on the North American stablecoin landscape: $5.32 trillion in volume settled in 2025, with U.S. issuers like Circle, Paxos, Ripple, and PayPal leading the charge. Institutional flows now represent 45% of large transactions.
Ripple is building an end-to-end institutional stack through key 2025 acquisitions:

Hidden Road (Ripple Prime) – clearing ~$3T annually
GTreasury (now Ripple Treasury) – orchestrating ~$13T in payments yearly
Rail – adding stablecoin-powered payments and liquidity bridging

This creates near-instant settlement, lower costs, and seamless fiat-to-blockchain movement with full institutional control.
If you're following XRP, RLUSD, Ripple news, tokenized real-world assets (RWA), stablecoins, or institutional crypto adoption in 2026 — this update is essential viewing.

🚀 JOIN THE JUNGLE INC COMMUNITY
The digital asset landscape is moving fast. Subscribe to stay updated on the institutional adoption of the XRP Ledger and the evolution of global liquidity.

🎯 PROFESSIONAL CRYPTO ANALYSIS
As an Enrolled Agent (EA) and dedicated content creator since 2018, I provide high-level analysis on the intersection of traditional finance and Web3. My coverage focuses on:

XRP & Ripple: Utility, legal developments, and global payment rails.

Layer 1 Infrastructure: Real-world asset (RWA) tokenization, DeFi, and scaling on Ethereum, Cardano, and Polkadot.

Macro Trends: Regulation, market cycles, and institutional capital flows.

This video contains news commentary and analysis intended for informational and educational purposes only. I am not a financial advisor. I am an Enrolled Agent, but the views expressed here are my personal opinions and do not constitute professional tax or investment advice. Cryptocurrency markets are highly volatile; always conduct your own research. Past performance is not indicative of future results.
